Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Are aged 16 or over
  -  Are competent and willing to provide written, informed consent
  -  Are experiencing delusions (A score of ≥3 on PANSS item P1, [OR]  P5  [OR] or P6)
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Significant developmental disability
  -  Currently receiving  [OR] or have received CBTp in the last 6 months
  -  Significant difficulty with the English language
